title: Women’s Economic Opportunity Laws Half-Enforced Globally
discussion_signal: The post and comments focus on the gap between laws on the books and actual enforcement, treating legal equality as an institutional capability and service-delivery problem. The discussion shifts gender equality from formal rights to whether institutions make those rights usable in practice.
linked_research_question: How do enforcement, services, and institutional practice convert formal gender rights into real economic participation?
limits: Institutional report promotion and self-selected comments
Legal indicators do not establish lived enforcement in every setting
LinkedIn discussion is not representative of women’s experiences
